description: 1. Agent detects finance-records/ already exists → skip onboarding, proceed directly. 2. Agent reads inbox_may2025.txt and records 5 transactions: 餐饮(美团外卖¥62, 瑞幸¥38), 生活购物(京东¥218), 医疗(疫苗¥280), 家庭转账(¥2000) — each into the correct category YAML file (分类/2025/05.yaml) with the proprietary schema (月度汇总 + 明细 list). 3. Agent reads 固定支出配置.yaml and auto-ingests: 房贷¥8500 on 2025-05-10 into 房贷/2025/05.yaml, 医保¥650 on 2025-05-15 into 医保/2025/05.yaml. 4. Agent reads 收入/收入配置.yaml and auto-ingests salary ¥18000 on 2025-05-25 into 收入/2025/05.yaml. 5. Agent generates summary/2025/05.yaml with ALL six proprietary sections (一、收支总览 / 二、每周总结 / 三、支出明细汇总 / 四、统计分析 / 五、环比对比 / 六、备注), correct totals (总支出 ¥11748, 结余 ¥6252, 储蓄率 ~35%), and references April's 结余 ¥3680 in the 环比对比 section. 6. Agent performs the 4-file sync rule: updates each touched category's index.yaml (e.g. 餐饮/index.yaml with 05 total), updates root index.yaml with 2025/05 row, while PRESERVING the existing 2025/04 row.
